phase_purpose: Phase 15 全体の設計完了を宣言し、最終実測確定判定層（Phases 15-1〜15-9）が reports-only として完成したこと、および app/tests 実装が NO_GO のままであることを確認する
execution_context: reports-only design phase completion declaration; no measurement, no implementation activation

governance.safety_rule: All blocked_actions remain strictly prohibited throughout Phase 15 and beyond. app/tests implementation remains NO_GO until BOTH integrated_decision=GO AND receiver_validator_implementation_permission=EFFECTIVE are confirmed via actual human review measurement (Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8).
governance.hard_stop_condition: Phase 15 completion does NOT open app/tests implementation. Measurement results (Phase 15-7, 15-8) must confirm both GO conditions before next gate can open.

design_artifact_validation.validation_method: Python json.load() verification + git status tracking
design_artifact_validation.validation_result: All 9 Phase 15 files (15-1 through 15-9) pass JSON schema validation

architectural_context.combined_design_purpose: Create a reports-only, multi-layer gate structure from human review frameworks (Phase 8) through final measurement confirmation (Phase 15) that validates app/tests implementation can proceed ONLY when BOTH integrated_decision=GO AND receiver_validator_implementation_permission=EFFECTIVE are confirmed from actual human review data

integrated_decision_status.definition: Top-level decision whether app/tests implementation is permitted
integrated_decision_status.transition_rule: Changes to GO only when Phase 15-7 measurement confirms criteria met with actual human review data
integrated_decision_status.hard_invariant: Remains NO_GO throughout Phases 1-15 design; only actual measurement can change it

receiver_validator_implementation_permis.definition: Permission for receiver_validator implementation module activation
receiver_validator_implementation_permis.transition_rule: Changes to EFFECTIVE only when Phase 15-8 measurement confirms BOTH integrated_decision=GO AND all 5 permission criteria met
receiver_validator_implementation_permis.hard_invariant: Remains NOT_EFFECTIVE throughout Phases 1-15 design; only actual measurement can activate it

app_implementation_status.transition_rule: Can only become GO when integrated_decision=GO AND receiver_validator_implementation_permission=EFFECTIVE (requires BOTH Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 confirmation)
app_implementation_status.hard_invariant: Remains NO_GO throughout all 15 phases of design; no app code changes permitted during design phases

tests_implementation_status.transition_rule: Same as app_implementation_status (requires BOTH 15-7 and 15-8 confirmation)
tests_implementation_status.hard_invariant: Remains NO_GO throughout all 15 phases of design; no test code changes permitted during design phases

production_status.transition_rule: Hardcoded NO_GO across all phases; not subject to measurement confirmation
production_status.hard_invariant: Remains NO_GO throughout entire Phase 1-15 design and through Phase 15-7 and 15-8 measurement; can only change after all measurement phases complete AND human review confirms readiness

required_human_review_data_entry.data_source: Actual human review decision (not template, not auto-generated)
required_human_review_data_entry.concrete_fields: Human reviewer ID, review timestamp, integrated_decision judgment (GO or NO_GO), supporting evidence references, confidence assessment

required_human_review_data_entry.data_source: Actual human review decision (not template, not auto-generated)
required_human_review_data_entry.concrete_fields: Human reviewer ID, review timestamp, permission judgment (EFFECTIVE or NOT_EFFECTIVE), implementation readiness assessment, supporting evidence references

measurement_input_requirements.prerequisite_completion: All Phase 14 (final decision layer) evidence and feasibility assessments must be complete and locked before Phase 15-1 and 15-2 human review data entry can begin

measurement_workflow_summary.phase_15_7_workflow: integrated_decision final actual measurement GO/NO-GO judgment report
phase_15_7_key_steps: Confirm Phase 15-1 human data entry complete
measurement_workflow_summary.phase_15_8_workflow: receiver_validator permission final actual measurement EFFECTIVE/NOT_EFFECTIVE judgment report
phase_15_8_key_steps: Check integrated_decision prerequisite (must be GO from Phase 15-7)
Confirm Phase 15-2 human data entry complete
measurement_workflow_summary.combined_decision_logic: app/tests implementation gate opens ONLY if Phase 15-7 reports integrated_decision=GO AND Phase 15-8 reports receiver_validator_implementation_permission=EFFECTIVE

design_phase_closure.design_closure_statement: Phase 15 (Final Actual Measurement Confirmation Design Layer) is fully complete as a reports-only design artifact. All 9 subphases (15-1 through 15-9) have been created, validated, and documented. No app/ or tests/ implementation has been initiated. All design files pass JSON validation.

post_phase_15_status.what_happens_next: Phase 15 design is complete. Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 actual measurement awaits HUMAN REVIEW data entry.
prerequisites_for_measurement: Phase 15-1 human review input (integrated_decision judgment) must be entered as concrete JSON data
Phase 15-2 human review input (receiver_validator permission judgment) must be entered as concrete JSON data
Phase 14 evidence and assessments must be complete and locked
Human technical reviewer must validate Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 design structures
post_phase_15_status.trigger_for_phase_16_or_measurement: Once Phase 15-1 and 15-2 human data entry is complete, Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 measurement workflows can be executed to determine final GO/NOT_EFFECTIVE status and app/tests implementation readiness
post_phase_15_status.gate_statement_before_measurement: integrated_decision = NO_GO, receiver_validator_implementation_permission = NOT_EFFECTIVE, app_implementation_status = NO_GO, tests_implementation_status = NO_GO, production_status = NO_GO. These remain unchanged until actual human review data is measured in Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8.
